page.overview:
Who is Harris?

Captain Harris was a 23rd century Starfleet officer who served as the commanding officer of the Federation starship during the late 2260s.

In 2268, Harris commanded the Excalibur for the war games problems of the disastrous M-5 drills. When the M-5 malfunctioned in control of the , commanded by James T. Kirk, it caused the Enterprise phasers to fire full-power on the other ships that participated in the games, severely damaging the unshielded Excalibur, Harris and his first officer died early in the conflict, and all of the ship's approximately 400 crewmen were eventually lost.

The M-5 recorded, at Kirk's request, that no life remained aboard the hulk of Excalibur. ()
